data.label: Trigger Account Monitor
data.description: Begin monitoring existing customer accounts for churn-risk signals.

data.label: Collect Usage Data
data.description: Retrieve recent product usage and calculate the 30-day usage trend for each account.

data.label: Collect Support Signals
data.description: Fetch support tickets and identify tickets tagged with negative sentiment.

data.label: Collect Billing Signals
data.description: Check invoice history for late or failed payments for each account.

data.label: Score Churn Risk
data.description: Combine usage, support, and billing signals into a churn-risk score from 0 to 100.

data.label: Evaluate Risk Thresholds
data.description: Route each account based on its churn-risk score.

data.label: Notify CSM
data.description: Immediately notify the assigned Customer Success Manager for high-risk accounts.

data.label: Draft Retention Email
data.description: Generate a personalized retention outreach email for the account.

data.label: Queue Weekly Review
data.description: Add moderate-risk accounts to the weekly CSM review queue.

data.label: Continue Monitoring
data.description: Keep low-risk accounts under passive monitoring.

data.label: Log Scoring Decision
data.description: Record the churn score and input signals for audit purposes.

message: The workflow monitors churn-risk signals for customer accounts, scores each account, branches by risk threshold, triggers high-risk notifications and outreach drafts or queueing/passive monitoring, and logs every decision with supporting signals for audit.

workflow.workflowBrief: Monitor existing customer accounts for churn-risk signals: drop in product usage over the last 30 days, support tickets tagged negative-sentiment, and late or failed invoice payments. Score each account's churn risk from 0 to 100. For scores above 75, immediately notify the assigned Customer Success Manager and draft a personalized retention outreach email. For scores between 40 and 75, add the account to a weekly CSM review queue. For scores below 40, continue passive monitoring. Log every scoring decision with the input signals for audit.
